name: berlin-daily-0300-spring-transition
description: An automation rule firing at 03:00 in Berlin across the spring transition (29 March 2026), which is G-08's acceptance case. 03:00 is the first reading that exists on the morning the clocks jump from 02:00 to 03:00, so the rule fires at the same local hour every night while the instant moves by one hour. A schedule tested only at 09:00 would never touch the edge this case sits on.
